title: Skulls and Shadows
dateBasis: UTC, from the archived creation timestamp
method: Every work in the room was inspected directly from the published WebP at 640 px in room order and as one wall before writing. Numbers come from data/gallery.json or data/abstract.json. No model inference calls were made; the text was written by the assistant in the session.
scope: The owned subset: the 20 works the locked structure places in this room, in room order.
introduction: Skulls, hoods and heads coming out of the dark. The twenty works in this room share a ground of black or near-black, and what the drawing does is pull a face out of it: with a halo of ochre, a white line, a pair of lit eyes, a grille of teeth. They run from December 2021 to April 2022.

Two kinds of dark are here. In some works the black is a flat ground, and the head is drawn on it in line, as in the hooded skull with letters on its brow, made in twenty-six strokes. In others the black is paint, and the head is modelled out of it with highlights, as in the blue head with yellow slit eyes.
Watch the teeth. They are nearly the only white in most of these pictures, and they are what the eye finds first: a zipper, a grille, four fangs, a row of pegs hanging from a jaw.

chapters.title: Heads in the Dark
chapters.opening: Four works from December 4 to 6, 2021. A head in an ochre halo, a black head on white, a blue head lit from inside, and a face in a pink frame.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #36
works.text: A head on black inside a halo of ochre, with two target eyes in yellow rings, a white zigzag along the brow, and a mouth of white teeth drawn like a zipper. Inside the head the fill is colored scribble, cyan, pink and yellow, with black line over it. The halo is the only soft thing in the picture, a band of brown that keeps the head from falling into the black. The series' first dark work.
works.caption: A head on black in a halo of ochre, two target eyes in yellow rings, teeth like a zipper.
works.reading: The eyes are yellow rings with a white and black target inside, sitting in boxes of colored scribble. The teeth are a row of white bars with a line through the middle, in a white box tilted to the left. The zigzag on the brow is white and blue.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #37
works.text: A black head on a white ground, with one ringed eye and one boxed eye, a long nose, and a grille of grey teeth in a red mouth, its inside a tangle of colored scribble.
works.caption: A black head on white, one ringed eye and one boxed eye, grey teeth in a red mouth, scribble inside.
works.reading: The ringed eye at the left is an orange and white target; the boxed eye at the right is a small square with a dot. The teeth are grey bars in a red box, and a second small row sits below them. A white zigzag runs along the top.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #38
works.text: A dark blue head with two yellow slit eyes and a grin of white teeth, painted in blue and black with white highlights along the crown. The eyes glow in their sockets, and the light on the head comes from the upper left, picking out the brow and leaving the jaw in shadow. The grin curves up at the right. The only painted head in the room that shines, and the first.
works.caption: A dark blue head painted in blue and black, two yellow slit eyes glowing, a grin curving up.
works.reading: The slits are tall and narrow, yellow with a dark line through each, set in black sockets. The highlights on the crown are white and cyan strokes laid over blue. The teeth are small white triangles in a red mouth.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #44
works.text: A face in a frame of pink loops on dark red, with one eye a sun of orange rays and the other an arched box, and a grille of white teeth at the bottom.
works.caption: A face framed in pink loops on dark red, one eye a sun of orange rays, one an arched box.
works.reading: The sun eye at the left is a ring of orange rays around a white center. The arched eye at the right is a box with a rounded top and a smaller box inside. The teeth are white bars in a grey box. The pink loops run around the whole edge.

chapters.title: Skulls and Hoods
chapters.opening: January 21 to February 9, 2022. Seven works in three weeks: a ghost skull, a skull in white line, a tall head with starburst eyes, and four hooded figures.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #56
works.text: A skull drawn in yellow and orange loops over a ground of vertical dark strokes, with two hollow eyes and a grille of white teeth, like a ghost in a curtain.
works.caption: A skull in yellow and orange loops over vertical dark strokes, two hollow eyes, a grille of white teeth.
works.reading: The loops run around the skull several times without closing, and the ground shows through them in bands of black, brown and gold. The eyes are two dark boxes. The teeth are white bars in a box at the bottom.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #59
works.text: A face drawn in white and red line on dark red, with X marks in both eyes, spiky lashes, and a small mouth of fangs, in forty-seven strokes.
works.caption: A face in white and red line on dark red, both eyes crossed out, spiky lashes, small fangs.
works.reading: The line is drawn in long loops that cross the whole square, and the face is a box inside them with two ringed eyes crossed out. The lashes are short white spikes above the eyes. The mouth is a small oval with white fangs.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #63
works.text: A tall head on dark teal with two starburst eyes under spiky lashes, a green cross for a nose, and a mouth of five white teeth in a box. The head is drawn in white, orange and cyan line over soft vertical strokes of blue and grey, so it seems to stand in rain. The two eyes are different: a white disc at the left, an orange ring at the right. The cross on the nose is drawn in green zigzag.
works.caption: A tall head on dark teal, starburst eyes, a green cross for a nose, five white teeth in a box.
works.reading: The lashes are drawn as rays around each eye, white on the left and cyan on the right. The mouth is a box with five white bars outlined in orange. The outline of the head is drawn twice, in black and in cyan.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #71
works.text: A black mass of hair on grey, and in it a face: two white eyes with dark pupils, a short line for a nose, and four white fangs. Twenty-three recorded strokes, the fewest in the room. The hair is drawn as a few loops of white line over black, and the black is one shape. The whole face is the eyes and the fangs.
works.caption: A black mass of hair on grey with two white eyes and four white fangs, drawn in twenty-three strokes.
works.reading: The hair hangs down both sides of the face to the bottom edge, and the loops of white over it are loose and few. The eyes are white ovals with black pupils, set close together. The fangs are four white triangles pointing down.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #72
works.text: A hooded skull on black, drawn in white line with a red hood, and the letters N N X Y Z written in red across its brow and its eyes. Two rows of white teeth sit below. Two hands rest at the bottom in red outline. Twenty-six strokes. The letters are the artist's name, and they sit on the skull where the eyes should be, so the name does the looking.
works.caption: A hooded skull on black in white line, the letters NNXYZ written in red across its brow and eyes.
works.reading: The skull is drawn in white loops, and the hood is a red outline around it that runs down to the shoulders. The N and N sit on the brow, the X, Y and Z across the two eye sockets. The teeth are two rows of white bars.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #73
works.text: A hooded figure on black, its hood and shoulders outlined with yellow dots, a white face with one sun-burst eye and one red star eye, and a grille of white teeth in a red box.
works.caption: A hooded figure on black outlined with yellow dots, a sun-burst eye and a red star eye, white teeth.
works.reading: The dots are small yellow circles drawn at even spacing along the edge of the hood and the shoulders. The face is white with a long nose. The left eye is yellow rays around a red center; the right is a red star.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #74
works.text: A hooded head painted in orange and brown, with no face at all except a wide grin of white teeth in the dark of the hood.
works.caption: A hooded head painted in orange and brown, faceless except for a wide grin of white teeth.
works.reading: The hood is painted in soft strokes of orange, red and brown, with a few thin orange lines over it. Inside the hood is dark, with pale shapes where cheeks would be. The teeth are white blocks in a curved row.

chapters.title: Beams and Blue Eyes
chapters.opening: February 12 to 21, 2022. A horned head, a skull with pink eyes lit by beams, a skull with blue eyes, and a bird skull.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #84
works.text: A horned dark head on green, with two tall white eyes under a heavy brow and a grille of yellow teeth, drawn in black and blue scribble over soft green blobs.
works.caption: A horned dark head on green with two tall white eyes and a grille of yellow teeth.
works.reading: The horns are two black points at the top corners of the head. The eyes are tall white ovals with dark pupils, in boxes. The teeth are yellow and white bars in a red mouth. The green ground is made of soft overlapping discs.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #88
works.text: A skull with two huge pink eyes, each a ring of magenta rays around a white center, lit by pale beams that cross the square from the upper left. The skull is drawn in black and colored line over dark, and the mouth is a row of white triangle teeth in a dark box. The beams are the first in the Faces, soft bands laid over everything. Where they fall, the lines show through them.
works.caption: A skull with two huge pink eyes, each a ring of magenta rays, lit by pale beams from above.
works.reading: The eyes fill most of the upper head, and the rays around them are drawn in magenta and pink with white inside. The beams are two broad diagonals of pale grey. The teeth are white triangles in two rows.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #90
works.text: A skull painted in pink, brown and grey on black, with two blue eyes in dark sockets, each a ring of blue with a white highlight, and a row of white teeth hanging from the jaw at the lower right. Nothing is outlined. The skull is modelled in soft strokes with a thin white edge. Where the blue head of December glowed from inside, this one is lit from the front, and the eyes look wet.
works.caption: A skull painted in pink, brown and grey on black, two wet blue eyes in dark sockets, teeth hanging.
works.reading: The sockets are deep and dark, and the blue eyes inside them are rings with a bright center. The teeth hang in a row at the lower right, white with grey shadows, some of them loose. Thin pink line runs over the dome of the skull.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #94
works.text: A bird skull with a long beak, drawn in black, white, red and cyan strokes on dark brown, a brush of pale lines hanging from the jaw like a beard.
works.caption: A bird skull with a long beak in black, white and cyan strokes, pale lines brushed under the jaw.
works.reading: The beak points down and to the left, drawn as a long triangle with a dark line down the middle. The eye is a white ring. The strokes on the head are thick and curved, like feathers. The brush under the jaw is short pale lines in cyan and white.

chapters.title: Spring Skulls
chapters.opening: March 16 to April 25, 2022. Five heads: a box with an X eye, a chunky head with a heart for an eye, a head of blocks, a glossy bald head, and a skull with its jaw off.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #107
works.caption: A dark box head on purple, a red X in a round eye, a boxed eye, teeth below.
works.reading: The round eye at the left is a black ring with a red X inside. The right eye is a tall box with a smaller box in it. The teeth are a bar of white dashes in a red box at the bottom. Yellow and blue line runs over the purple.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #108
works.text: A chunky head on dark grey with a red heart in a box for an eye, a box of white teeth, and two more boxes of teeth at the bottom like feet, in confetti scribble.
works.caption: A chunky head on dark grey, a red heart in a box for an eye, teeth boxes below like feet.
works.reading: The heart is red with a yellow bar through it, in a box at the upper left. The teeth are white blocks in a red box in the middle of the face. The two boxes of teeth at the bottom corners stand under the head on short legs. The scribble is every color.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #112
works.text: A head built from stacked blocks on dark navy, with one eye in a tilted box and the other a cluster of rings, a long bar of white teeth at the bottom.
works.caption: A head built from stacked blocks on dark navy, one eye in a tilted box, a long bar of teeth.
works.reading: The blocks are drawn in grey, pink and yellow with black edges, and they are modelled with highlights so they look solid. The tilted eye at the right is a white box with a dark pupil. The teeth are white blocks in a long box.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #122
works.text: A glossy bald head on black, its skin a weave of colored scribble, two ringed eyes, and a mouth open on white teeth, one eye at the right lit white.
works.caption: A glossy bald head on black, its skin a weave of colored scribble, mouth open on white teeth.
works.reading: The scribble is yellow, pink, green and cyan over dark grey, and it follows the curve of the skull. The eyes are two rings with a dark center. The mouth is a wide oval with white teeth top and bottom. A pale patch at the right is the lit side of the head.

works.title: nnxyz nifty faces #128
works.text: A glossy skull on pink with spiky hair, one huge yellow eye, and its jaw come off, lying below the teeth as a separate row. The skull is painted in gold and black with white highlights, and the teeth hang from the upper jaw in a row of long pegs. Two months after the skull with blue eyes, the modelled skull is back, and this time it has come apart. The last work in the room, from April 25, 2022.
works.caption: A glossy skull on pink with spiky hair and one huge yellow eye, its jaw lying separate below.
works.reading: The hair is a crest of short black and blue spikes along the top. The eye is a yellow ring with a dark pupil in a deep socket, and a smaller eye sits at the left in profile. The jaw at the bottom is drawn as a curved bar of teeth with grey shadows.

closing: Look again at the hooded skull with the letters across its eyes, twenty-six strokes on black, and then at the glossy skull on pink with its jaw on the floor. One is nothing but line. The other is modelled, lit and broken. Both are skulls in the dark, and both make you look at the teeth.
